simple.summary: נְטֹפָה (Nᵉṭôphâh) means Netophah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 22.

definitions.full: H5199. Netophah נְטֹפָה proper name, of a location in Judah ( dropping, dripping , compare Lewy Semitic Fremdwörter 40 ); — Ezra 2:22 = Neh 7:26 ; ᵐ5 . Νετωφα , ᵐ5 L Νετωφαγι (as adjective, of a people 12:28 ).
